title: 第23章 太上老君才是最快的男人第24章 花果山炼丹群猴感觉手里的桃子都不香了
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 玉面公主一脸问号，这才过去多久，就，炼好了！
这个男人，不，男妖，也太快了吧！
心中有些一丝怀疑，玉面公主缓步走了过来。
下一瞬，丹炉开启，只见里面躺着一颗泛着七彩光辉的丹药，如露珠般剔透。
香气穿透丹炉，好似化为实质，直通心底。
玉面公主见过关于寿元丹的描写，跟眼前一般无二。
当下就无比确定，这就是寿元丹！
竟真的这么短时间就炼制出来了！
怀着深深的震动，玉面公主伸手小心翼翼的将寿元丹从丹炉里取出。
仔细打量之下，发现在寿元丹表面，浮现神秘纹路，好似暗含天地法则。
这，这是完美级的寿元丹！
玉面公主想到寿元丹的描述，唯有完美级的寿元丹，表面才会有这样的纹路。
这是天地法则的证明，代表已然完美。
我的天，不仅这么短时间炼制出寿元丹，还是完美级的。
这一刻，玉面公主才知晓，这位黄风大王的炼丹水平，比她想象之中还要高！
玉面公主这里被震撼的无以复加，叶云那边却很平静。
毕竟他的炼丹水平连仙丹都能炼制，何况区区一枚寿元丹。
再加上灵宝级的丹炉，这要是还耗费大量时间，那他可以去死了。
而且，他这速度也不算什么，要是那位太上老君炼制，速度更快好吧。
所以，太上老君才是那个最快的男人，咳咳。
玉面公主回过神来，看向叶云的眼神异彩连连。
这位黄风大王不仅成功炼制出来，还超额完成。
“多谢黄风大王，此恩无以为报，恐此丹药效流失，请容许小女子先拿此丹回去，待之后再和家父前来好好感谢大王。”
“公主请便。”
玉面公主行了一礼后，便使用传送法宝离开了。
目送对方离去，叶云第一时间拿出刚刚的芥子袋，开始盘点。
天材地宝那些单独拿出来，放在他原本那个芥子袋里。
然后就是能够炼器的材料，他都一股脑的给无量剑胎给吞了，成为其晋升的养料。
余下的，大多都是一些美酒佳肴这些。
老实说，美酒的确是美酒，但佳肴就不一定了。
毕竟这个时期做菜就那样，人族也不例外，更别说妖怪了。
只能说多亏了食材好，怎么做味道都还行，不然还真吃不下去。
叶云自己留下了一些。
剩下的，他叫来小妖，去给群妖一一发放下去。
这些叶云看不上，但对群妖来说，就是珍馐美味了。
一个个吃的不亦乐乎，从未感觉如此幸福过。
听着群妖们的欢呼雀跃声，叶云微微一笑，他望向东胜神州的方向。
“差不多了，该去花果山了。”
传音给群妖们，自己要外出一段时间后，便身化剑光，冲天而起。
另一边。
玉面公主回到摩云洞后，第一时间找到万岁狐王，拿出了那枚寿元丹。
content_en:
"???"
The Jade Faced Princess had a question mark on her face, how long had it passed, and she was ready!
This man, no, male demon, is too fast!
With some suspicion in her heart, the Jade-faced Princess walked over slowly.
The next moment, the alchemy furnace was opened, and there was a colorful elixir lying inside, as clear as dewdrops.
The aroma penetrates the alchemy furnace and seems to turn into substance, reaching straight to the bottom of the heart.
Princess Jade Face has seen descriptions of Shou Yuan Dan, and they are exactly the same as before.
I was extremely sure at that moment, this was the Shou Yuan Dan!
It was actually refined in such a short time!
With deep shock, Princess Jade Face reached out and carefully took out the Shou Yuan Pill from the pill furnace.
After careful inspection, I found that mysterious lines appeared on the surface of Shouyuan Dan, which seemed to imply the laws of heaven and earth.
This, this is the perfect Shou Yuan Dan!
Princess Jade Face thought of the description of the Shou Yuan Dan. Only the perfect Shou Yuan Dan would have such lines on its surface.
This is proof of the laws of heaven and earth, representing perfection.
My God, not only was the Shou Yuan Dan refined in such a short time, it was also perfect.
At this moment, Princess Jade Face realized that King Huang Feng's alchemy level was higher than she had imagined!
Princess Jade Face was extremely shocked, but Ye Yun was very calm.
After all, his alchemy skills can even refine elixirs, let alone just a longevity pill.
Coupled with the Lingbao level pill furnace, if this still takes a lot of time, then he can die.
Moreover, his speed is nothing. If the Taishang Laojun refines it, the speed will be faster.
Therefore, Taishang Laojun is the fastest man, ahem.
Princess Jade Face came back to her senses and looked at Ye Yun with brilliant eyes.
Not only did the King of Yellow Wind successfully refine it, he also exceeded the target.
"Thank you so much, King Huangfeng. I cannot repay this kindness. I am afraid that the efficacy of this elixir will be lost. Please allow me to take this elixir back home first, and then I can come with my father to express my gratitude to the king."
"Princess, please."
After the Jade Faced Princess bowed, she used the teleportation magic weapon and left.
After watching the other party leave, Ye Yun immediately took out the mustard seed bag and began to take stock.
He took out the treasures of heaven, materials and earth separately and put them in his original mustard bag.
Then there were the materials that could be used to refine weapons, all of which he swallowed up for Wuliang Sword Embryo, becoming the nourishment for his advancement.
The rest is mostly wine and food.
To be honest, good wine is good wine, but good food is not necessarily good.
After all, cooking is like that in this period, and humans are no exception, let alone monsters.
I can only say that thanks to the good ingredients, it tastes good no matter how you prepare it, otherwise I really wouldn’t be able to eat it.
Ye Yun kept some for himself.
He called the little demon to give out the rest to the group of demons one by one.
Ye Yun doesn't like these things, but to the demons, they are delicacies.
Everyone enjoyed the meal and had never felt so happy.
Listening to the cheers of the demons, Ye Yun smiled slightly and looked in the direction of Dongsheng Shenzhou.
"It's almost time to go to Huaguo Mountain."
After sending a message to the group of monsters that he was going out for a while, he turned into a sword and rose into the sky.
…
other side.
After Princess Jade Face returned to Moyun Cave, she immediately found the Long Live Fox King and took out the Longevity Pill.
